content.text:
Fixed walking: **WASD, arrow keys, and the mobile movement pad now work while dialogue is on screen**, so you don’t have to finish Alfred’s conversation before moving.

Validated the game script syntax. I assumed movement being locked during the opening dialogue was the issue.
